$comment: Every art source we ship from. A pack that is not redistributable cannot be listed here: our world files hand assets to other players by design. See docs/DECISIONS.md D12.

packs.name: Universal Animation Library
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.take: Locomotion, idles, sitting, talking, pickup, drive. Binds to the canonical skeleton with no retargeting.

packs.name: Universal Animation Library 2
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.take: Carry, consume, lean on rail, fold arms, phone, yes/no. Same skeleton.

packs.name: Universal Base Characters
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.take: The bodies every NPC is built from, and the skeleton the clips bind to.

packs.name: Downtown City MegaKit
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.take: Street level: shopfronts, cornices, fire escapes, rooftop plant, street furniture. Its concrete also tiles the inside of a building and paints the city's roadway, whose relief and wear are derived from that colour map by tools/textures/relief.mjs and committed under assets/gen, which the CC0 licence allows us to ship.

packs.name: KayKit Character Animations
packs.author: Kay Lousberg
packs.attribution: Kay Lousberg, www.kaylousberg.com (asked for, not required)
packs.take: Second clip source: sits, waves, strafes, tool loops. Retargeted onto the canonical skeleton.

packs.name: Modular Character Outfits
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.take: Clothing parts on the same rig as the base bodies. The free tier is four fantasy outfits; tools/build-wardrobe.mjs recuts them for a night city: the belts, bracers and pauldrons are dropped, the knee boots cut back to the shoe, and both texture sheets repainted per outfit.

packs.name: Low Poly Cars
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.take: The traffic and the car the player drives.

packs.name: glb-buildings
packs.author: Hector Oviedo
packs.take: The producer @gb/prefab bakes its building pack with, offline. Its drawn-from-code tiles only: the image packs it can also carry have no licence record and never reach the pack.

packs.name: CARBON MOTORS E7 POLICE (Cities Skylines)
packs.author: TSB3DMODELS
packs.byHand: Sketchfab asks for a login, so the file is saved by hand into assets/src/carbon-motors-e7/ and fitted with `node tools/fit-model.mjs <file> --out assets/src/carbon-motors-e7 --keep-parts --bake`.
packs.take: The Patrol in the traffic: a police car, 1,660 triangles, its livery baked onto its vertices.

packs.name: 2018 Audi e-tron GT Concept
packs.author: Ddiaz Design
packs.byHand: Sketchfab asks for a login, so the file is saved by hand into assets/src/audi-e-tron-gt/ and fitted with `node tools/fit-model.mjs <file> --out assets/src/audi-e-tron-gt --keep-parts --bake --spare cab`.
packs.take: The GranTurismo in the traffic. Its own metadata says CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, which D12 does not admit; it is on the streets because the owner put it there.

packs.name: FREE Concept Car 037 - public domain (CC0)
packs.author: Unity Fan youtube channel
packs.byHand: Sketchfab asks for a login, so the file is saved by hand into assets/src/concept-car-037/ and fitted with `node tools/fit-model.mjs <file> --out assets/src/concept-car-037 --keep-parts --bake`.
packs.take: The Concept in the traffic. Its page is titled public domain (CC0) and its file says SKETCHFAB Standard; it is on the streets because the owner put it there.
